description: omniroute (self-hosted OmniRoute gateway, auto-routed combos) — auto/fast explores on flash (ship-fast weights), auto/chat carries the high-traffic standard tier (balanced default), auto/coding codes on pro (quality-first weights), auto/reasoning:pro judges on max (reasoning-only + premium pool), auto/vision handles vision (vision-capable pool). Requires OMNIROUTE_BASE_URL + OMNIROUTE_API_KEY environment variables.
